messages:
maria (infra): Heads-up: saw a regression after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak — +1.8ms p50 on small chat requests (single-token prompts). Spike appears at ~09:12 UTC and correlates with the deploy.

kevin (runtime): yup I saw the dashboard bump. flamegraph link: https://perf.redwood/team/3333311111 — top hotspots look host-side not GPU.

jena (perf): quick paste from sampling: 
```
# top CPU samples (staging canary)
host_lexer::tokenize +38%
http2::frame_coalesce +21%
runtime::kernel_selection +12%
kv_cache::lookup_miss +9%
```

liam (backend): kv cache miss rate for tiny requests jumped ~2.3x after the selector change. Could be key churn.

sam (sre): repro script I used: 
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 500); do curl -sS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"hi"}' $INGRESS_URL | jq -r .latency; done | ~/bin/stats
```
Gives stable increase on p50/p95.

kevin (runtime): FYI the new selector added a `batch_hint` field into KernelKey and for seqlen<=8 we set a mini-batch hint that's generated per-request in edge flow. Code: `kernel_selector.cpp:412 return KernelKey{arch, seqlen_bucket, batch_hint};`

maria (infra): that smells like a non-deterministic component in the kvcache key. If `batch_hint` is ephemeral we'll fragment the cache and explode misses.

jena (perf): ran a quick staging rollback of batch_hint->stable-enum for short seqlens: kv-miss dropped from ~12% -> ~3%, p50 regressed back down ~1.6ms. Patch looks promising. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4521

kevin (runtime): good catch. Also noticed http2 coalescer change aimed at improving throughput now waits up to 800us before flushing short streams (we batch frames until N tokens). For single-token interactive streams that adds tail latency. Suggest: `flush_on_eof` or heuristic: if seqlen <= 8 then bypass coalesce.

liam (backend): +1 to bypass for tiny requests. We can add a per-connection short-stream hint so we don't regress larger flows.

maria (infra): action items: 
1) rollback batch_hint change for small seqlen (kevin)
2) add flush_on_eof or short-seqlen bypass in http2 coalescer (liam)
3) add unit/regression perf test for kvcache key stability and a microbenchmark for 1-token streams (jena)
I'll file an incident ticket and tag owners.

perf-bot: canary deploy update: deploy canary-2 succeeded at 3333311120 (no errors).

sam (sre): I'll add a transient alert: if chat-small p50 > 10ms fire page and rollback. Monitoring window 5m.

kevin (runtime): opening rollback PR now, linking CI when green. will also add deterministic batch_hint enum for <=8.

maria (infra): thanks — let's watch canary and then roll to prod if stable. Please paste perf diffs in this thread.

kevin (runtime): will do. short-term rollback + coalescer tweak should recover most of the regression.

jena (perf): once rolled I'll run the microbench harness and post flamegraphs.

maria (infra): +1. Owning incident: #INC-2026, assignees kevin/jena/liam.

sam (sre): noted. monitoring enabled.

kevin (runtime): PRs: #4521 (rollback/batch-hint fix) and #4522 (http2 coalesce bypass). CI started.

maria (infra): thanks everyone.
